studies.title: Wheat
studies.caption: The dense ears of wheat hold grains that can be stored and ground into flour. Early farmers carried the crop outward from the Fertile Crescent.
studies.prompt: Close natural-history study of ancient emmer wheat Triticum dicoccum, mature golden awned ears and narrow leaves, a small loose cluster of grains on pale soil near base. Dry Fertile Crescent hillside field behind. Ears correctly attached to stems, no rice panicles, no modern combine.
